news.analysis: Mendoza threw the first three touchdown passes of his career, connecting with Ashton Jeanty, Ian Thomas and Jack Bech. The rookie helped the Raiders erase a 17-point deficit but was sacked five times and threw a pick-six late in the fourth quarter. All things considered, Mendoza put together a productive fantasy performance against a difficult matchup in his second career start. He enters the QB2 conversation in Superflex leagues heading into Week 12 against Cleveland.
news.contents: Fernando Mendoza completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for 22 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
news.title: Fernando Mendoza throws three touchdowns in Week 11

news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza was lackluster during his first career start, but he put together an impressive performance on Sunday. Mendoza threw for 267 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in the loss to the Denver Broncos. There were certainly problems, including a late-game pick-six, but Mendoza looked much better in his second career start. He appears to be getting more comfortable under center and will hopefully get the good times rolling against the ...

news.analysis: Black has been an excellent spell to starting RB Christian McCaffrey this season, but the rookie was not able to get much going with his seven touches Sunday night. That's obviously disappointing when considering he had gone over 50 yards in each of the last three games, scoring twice in that stretch. Black's main fantasy value remains as a handcuff to McCaffrey.
